pages.title: Silken Liver Slipper
pages.text: Seattle, the home town of grunge, is the fourth race in Skitchin', and Silken Liver Slipper is its song. The course is 4.6 miles long, and the password AIRPORT takes you straight there.

pages.title: Grunge was the artists' idea
pages.text: Grunge wasn't part of the original plan for Skitchin'. The graffiti artists suggested it when they visited EA Canada. Composer Jeff van Dyck hadn't written many rock songs, so he shut himself away with a pile of Seattle grunge CDs.

pages.title: Top marks from GamePro
pages.text: GamePro gave Skitchin' 19.5 out of 20 and praised its 16-track soundtrack of "mind-blowing heavy metal." Hyper, an Australian magazine, gave it 89% and liked the way the music, the graffiti and the spray-can art all fit together.
